title: Can Language Models Learn While They Think? Testing Gradient Adaptation Across Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2610.33025v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Letting a language model take gradient steps on the text it is reading, known as dynamic evaluation, lowers its loss on the rest of the document. Its behaviour on hybrid linear-attention architectures, on diffusion language models, and on standard long-context benchmarks has not been measured. We measure it. With one SGD step per 128-token chunk on the MLP output projections of the last quarter of blocks, no training, and a 2k-token window, softmax-attention models (Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, Gemma-4-E4B) lose 5-8% of their next-token loss over a document and outperform the same frozen model given the full 32k-token context. Hybrid Gated-DeltaNet models (Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.8-27B) gain under 1% at every learning rate: the linear-attention blocks already perform the adaptation. translated_title: 语言模型能在思考时学习吗？跨架构测试梯度适应
translated_abstract: 让语言模型在阅读文本时对其所读内容进行梯度更新，即所谓的动态评估，可以降低模型对文档其余部分的预测损失。然而，该方法在混合线性注意力架构、扩散语言模型以及标准长上下文基准上的表现尚未被测量过。我们对此进行了测量。在每128个token的数据块上，对模型最后四分之一 Transformer 块的 MLP 输出投影执行一次 SGD 步骤——无需任何训练，仅使用2k token的窗口——softmax 注意力模型（Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B、Gemma-4-E4B）在整个文档上将下一个 token 预测损失降低了5-8%，并且优于给定完整32k token 上下文的相同冻结模型。混合 Gated-DeltaNet 模型（Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen3.8-27B）在所有学习率下的增益均低于1%：因为线性注意力块本身已经在执行这种适应。该机制还可以迁移到掩码扩散模型上且效果更大——在降低学习率和更新频率后，Nemotron-Diffusion-8B 上损失降低8%，DiffusionGemma-26B 上达到17-20%。
tldr: 该论文首次跨架构系统测试了动态评估（阅读时梯度适应）的效果，发现 softmax 注意力模型可降低5-8%的预测损失并超越使用完整32k上下文的冻结模型，而线性注意力混合模型因已内置适应机制增益不足1%，掩码扩散模型则效果最大（8-20%）。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first systematic cross-architecture test of dynamic evaluation (gradient adaptation while reading), showing that softmax-attention models cut next-token loss by 5-8% and beat frozen models given the full 32k-token context, while hybrid linear-attention models gain under 1% due to built-in adaptation and masked-diffusion models benefit most (8-20%).
